findings.claim: TARGET 5 (P1 durable) -- the resolved usd_root lives under a Houdini Temp dir. Observed live path from the probe: C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp\<tmp>\.synapse\.moneta\cortex_root.usda; on the real seat it is $HOUDINI_TEMP_DIR/untitled/.synapse/.moneta/cortex_root.usda. LIFECYCLE RISK: a Temp cleanup / reboot wipes the cortex, the Moneta snapshot, AND the JSONL safety net together (they share the store dir). This is the same durability gap the Moneta 'Phase 1 Durability' work names. Recorded, not silently accepted (crucible criterion 3).

HONEST SCOPE (crucible criterion 4): the round-trip + dual-write are verified at the STORE-ADAPTER level (write->cortex_root.usda->query; add->memory.jsonl). This does NOT claim store-level production health -- reads are still served from moneta, the cortex is a materialized mirror, and the live seat needs a server restart to reconstruct the store (per W3-DIM's live finding).

DEAD BYTES remains: schema_in_use=True but schema_registered=False, so authoring is schema-blind (Sdf writes the typeName token with or without registration, R75). in_use=True is exactly the claim this leg makes; a working TYPED substrate additionally needs PXR_PLUGINPATH_NAME registration, which nothing in packages/synapse.json sets today.

PROVENANCE: the brief's source.doc docs/SYNAPSE-memory-engineering-spec.md is ABSENT from this worktree (Glob + Read confirm). The brief is self-contained (embeds full targets/acceptance/crucible_criteria and states 'This brief is complete'); executed against the embedded contract. The 'write(kind,id,payload)/query as typed prims keyed (kind,id)' and 'MonetaMemory root prim with version attribute' phrasings are implemented literally.

REBASE-COMPATIBILITY with the in-flight store work (crucible SEAM GUARD). fix/memory-store-recovery is ALREADY MERGED into base (HEAD 5e933c13 == its tip) -> this wave builds ON it, no rebase, no drift. wave3/dim (16cf1543, the only unmerged sibling) edits from_storage_dir's MonetaConfig(embedding_dim=dim) and adds _resolve_embedding_dim/_reconcile_snapshot_dim BEFORE `cfg = MonetaConfig(...)`. This leg's cortex+jsonl init is a contiguous block placed AFTER `handle = mr.Moneta(cfg)` (the post-dim-check region -- handle construction is what the dim gate protects), uses only NEW names (UsdCortexStore, _write_cortex, _dual_write_jsonl, _ensure_keyfp_sidecar, dual_write_jsonl kwarg), and never touches the embedding_dim= lines -> no semantic overlap with the dim contract.

for_ruling.item: Durable store location (P1 durable). Target 5 asks to RECORD the Temp-dir risk, not fix it. Moving the Moneta/cortex/JSONL store off $HOUDINI_TEMP_DIR onto a durable address is a human call (it changes where every seat's memory lives). Recorded here; no code change made.

Schema registration (PXR_PLUGINPATH_NAME) to move moneta_substrate from in_use=True/registered=False (fail, DEAD BYTES) to registered AND in_use (status=ok). Owned by fix/moneta-schema-registration / packages/synapse.json (install-level env), out of this leg's scope.
